n: Wakadori Jidai Naruto Honten (若鶏時代なると 本店)
w: Otaru's soul food since 1952: a half young chicken from Date, seasoned only with salt and pepper and fried at 200 °C for 10–12 minutes — crackling outside, juicy inside.

n: LeTAO Main Store, Otaru (ルタオ本店)
address: East end of Sakaimachi Street, Otaru, Hokkaido, Japan
w: Otaru's patisserie of record at the end of Sakaimachi — the Double Fromage, a baked-and-rare two-layer cheesecake of Hokkaido dairy, plus store-only sweets.
